```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

db_path <- if (file.exists("../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")) {
  "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db"
} else {
  "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended"
}

con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_path)
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

```

## Task 1

```{r task1}
host_counts <- listings |> 
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_total_listings")

listings_t1 <- listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

# A1: Count of hosts with 10 or more listings
a1_large_hosts <- host_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(host_total_listings >= 10) |> 
  dplyr::n_distinct()

# A2: Percent of Chicago's listings held by hosts with >= 10 listings
a2_chicago_share <- listings_t1 |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct = mean(host_total_listings >= 10) * 100
  )

a1_large_hosts
a2_chicago_share

```

## Task 2

```{r task2}
# Q1: Which city has the highest average price for entire homes/apartments?
a3_highest_avg_price <- listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_price)) |> 
  dplyr::slice(1)

# Q2: Which neighborhood in Chicago has the highest median price across all listings?
a4_chicago_top_neighborhood <- listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(neighbourhood) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(median_price)) |> 
  dplyr::slice(1)

a3_highest_avg_price
a4_chicago_top_neighborhood

```

# Task 3


```{r task3}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(neighbourhood) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_listings = dplyr::n(),
    median_ppp = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(n_listings >= 20) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(median_ppp)

```

# Task 3.5

```{r task4}
listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities", room_type == "Entire home/apt")

```


# Task 4

```{r task5}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    top_10_cutoff = ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n()),
    is_top_10 = rank <= top_10_cutoff
  ) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[is_top_10], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_top_10 = (top_10_revenue / total_revenue) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus")

```


# Task 5 

```{r task6}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(
    availability |> dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10"), 
    by = "id"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_mostly_taken = mean(nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(pct_mostly_taken)

```


# Task 6

```{r task7}
reviews |> 
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07" & month <= "2026-06") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |> dplyr::select(id, city), 
    by = "id"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews)) |> 
  dplyr::slice(1)

```

# Task 6

```{r task8}
twin_cities_reviews <- reviews |> 
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07" & month <= "2026-06") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |> dplyr::select(id, city), 
    by = "id"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(month) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

busiest <- max(twin_cities_reviews$total_reviews)
quietest <- min(twin_cities_reviews$total_reviews)

ratio <- busiest / quietest
round(ratio, 2)
```

# Task 7 

```{r task10}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = host_is_superhost, 
    values_from = median_price
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(premium = t - f)
```


# Question 12
```{r task2_shares}
library(dplyr)

# A2 Share: % of listings held by hosts with 10+ listings
a2_shares <- listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(host_id) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(host_listing_count = dplyr::n()) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_listings_10plus = mean(host_listing_count >= 10, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )

# A5 Share: % of estimated revenue earned by top 10% of listings
a5_shares <- listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    top_10_cutoff = ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n()),
    is_top_10 = rank <= top_10_cutoff
  ) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_revenue_top_10 = (sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[is_top_10], na.rm = TRUE) / 
                           sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100
  )

dplyr::left_join(a2_shares, a5_shares, by = "city")
```
